findings: The NIKL guide describes **-(으)니까** as a reason/cause connective and contrasts it with **-아서/어서**: it allows a following suggestion or command in examples such as “비가 오니까 여행을 취소하자,” whereas the corresponding -아서/어서 construction is disallowed. The scope here is that contrast and these documented functions.
